title: Head pitch movement and vestibular neuronal activity in response to otolith stimulation of monkeys in space.
abstract: Head pitch movement and vestibular neuronal activity of two Bion 11 monkeys exposed to otolith stimulation were investigated. During flight both parameters went through facilitation and inhibition followed by enhancement. The resultant data suggest involvement of the visual input in the above changes.
journal: Journal of gravitational physiology : a journal of the International Society for Gravitational Physiology
